title: The Voyage Out
subtitle: England → St. Helena → Java
blurb: The sea-journal: leaving England, a female volunteer found aboard, the customs at the Tropic and the Equator, and the lonely rock-island of St. Helena with its strange little society.

title: Java, Batavia & Madura
subtitle: The islands and the Dutch
blurb: The Dutch emporium of Batavia, the island of Java, the 'Mutqueto' fly and the thief-catchers — and the heartbreaking dethronement of the King of Madura, delivered by the English to his enemies.

title: The Empire of China
subtitle: Pekin and the Middle Kingdom
blurb: From the Straits to China: the emperor, his palace and throne, a land with no lawyers, its printing, laws, armies and the ceremonial reception of ambassadors.

title: Canton & Its People
subtitle: The great trading port
blurb: The shops and streets of Canton: fishes sold alive, rats and dogs in the markets, blind beggars, the rude rabble, the author's attempt to glimpse the Chinese ladies — and the comforts and curiosities of the English factory.
